name: openPR

sources.title: Submit form spec (search-indexed) — 1 free release per 30 days; free-email addresses rejected; full postal address mandatory; image min 1200×900 for Google News pickup; business-hours activation
FAQ (search-indexed) — free route is /news/submit.html; releases go live Mon–Fri only, not immediately; credits for extra releases
GTC (search-indexed) — free publication limited to 1/month; credit points for additional releases; provider may exclude applications
Batch-provided submission URL — returned HTTP 403 (bot-blocked); real submit is /news/submit.html

conditions: Free tier is capped at 1 press release per 30 days; additional releases need paid credit points
Free email providers (Gmail etc.) are rejected — a company-domain email is required
Full postal address and complete press-contact details are mandatory — 'just an email address or URLs' is explicitly insufficient
requirements: A real press release — news-style copy (headline ≤110 chars, ≥80 words of coherent text), not a product ad
Complete contact block: company name, full postal address, press contact
Company-domain email (no Gmail/free providers — releases from them are deleted)
Image recommended: JPG/GIF min 1200×900, max 2000×2000, 1MB — 'without an image the press release WILL NOT be listed by Google News'
Link limits in text — submit page says max 5 intext backlinks; the FAQ says up to 3 links (keep to 3 to be safe)
preparation: Press-release copy announcing a real launch/news event
Company postal address, press contact name, company-domain email
A ≥1200×900 image (logo graphic or product shot)
Optional: paid credits if more than 1 release per 30 days is needed
workflow: Open https://www.openpr.com/news/submit.html (browser — the site 403s automated fetches)
Fill headline (≤110 chars), body, company portrait, full postal address, press contact, company-domain email
Attach the image; enter a credits code only if using paid volume
Submit — releases are activated during business hours Mon–Fri 9:00–17:00 CET; off-hours submissions sit in a waiting loop
Verify indexing with a site:openpr.com Google search on the release title
watchFor: Batch URL /user/register.html is not the submit route — use /news/submit.html
Duplicate/repeated releases, spam, and automated submission software get deleted
Adult, supplements and trademark-infringing content banned
Conflicting link limits across pages (3 vs 5) — stay ≤3
No same-day publication; only business days
countsAsLive: The press release page resolves at an openpr.com/news/... URL and is findable via site:openpr.com search
unknowns: Whether outbound links in releases are follow/nofollow on live pages
Current credit-point pricing (price list page not fetched)
Whether German openPR.de's free tier (2 releases/yr) differs from openpr.com's 1/month
